spots.note: 07:38 sunrise. Crossed-up short-period windswell, lines reform into whitewater with no held face. Scanned all 3 detail + 2 crowd frames: no bodies. Cam framed on water, land n/a
07:38 sunrise. Bay near flat, swell lines roll through unbroken, only wash on the point rocks. Empty in every detail and crowd frame. Cam framed on water, land n/a
07:38 sunrise. Cam stream unavailable (HLS 404), no video grabbed, so no cam read at all. Forecast-only line: FAIR, N wind offshore here. null not 0
07:38 sunrise. Long lines closing out along the beach, one shortish right off the north rock. Water empty in both crowd frames; 2 people at the shoreline by the flag
18:38 sunset. Wind-torn cross-shore chop, crumbling sectiony lines with no green face. Scanned all 3 detail + 2 crowd frames: no bodies. Cam framed on water, land n/a
18:38 sunset. Bay effectively flat, only wash on the rocks under the hotel. Left third burnt out by low-sun glare but the readable bay is empty in every frame. Cam framed on water, land n/a
18:38 sunset. Waist-high lines peeling along the reef with a green wall ahead of the foam, N wind offshore here but chattery. ~4 dark specks in the higher crowd frame; ~12 on promenade/sand
18:38 sunset. Sun straight into the lens, glare over most of the lineup: cannot resolve surfers, so null not 0. Wave is whitewater end to end. ~10 on the sand, approximate

15:32 afternoon run. Cam clear, bright full daylight, water readable edge to edge. Surface is wind-torn by the 18g23kt N cross-shore - heavy texture everywhere, waves breaking well outside as short crumbling sections that never stand up as a green wall; the whitewater is patchy and sectiony rather than one long peeling line. Scanned takeoff zone, both shoulders and the inside in all 3 detail frames and both crowd frames: no bodies, no boards, no paddling lines. Confident 0 out. One person leaning on the promenade wall at the right edge of the frame, but the cam is framed on the water so land count not applicable

15:32 afternoon run. Water fully legible, no glare, no blowout. The bay is very weak: thin reform lines sliding in towards the rock point with almost no height and no face ahead of the foam, plus uniform wind ripple across the whole bay. Nothing stands up in any of the 3 detail frames or the 6 sheet frames. Scanned the open bay, the corner by the rocks and the shorebreak in every frame: nobody in the water. 0 out, and with this little wave that is expected rather than a wasted lineup. Cam framed on the water, land count not applicable

15:32 afternoon run - cam UP again (second good run in a row after the sunrise 404). Sunny, deep blue, good visibility. Still the only working spot: waist-high lines breaking along the reef with a green face ahead of the foam in several frames, held up by the 18g23kt N blowing offshore here, but distinctly bumpier than the 11:31 run - 23kt gusts are putting chatter on the faces. Count is approximate: a scattered line of roughly 8 dark specks sitting out the back on the outside line, consistent across the +0s and +12s sheet frames, plus 3-4 resolvable in the crowd crops inside that same zone (higher of the two frames). Heavy wind chop makes an exact count impossible so 8 is a floor-ish read, not a precise figure. On land roughly 25: about 6 along the promenade railing and 15-20 sitting or walking on the sand. 8 out is right on the 8.0 average for this slot

15:32 afternoon run, wide distant cam so all counts approximate. Cam clean and bright. Wave is closing out badly: a continuous wall of whitewater across the whole beach dumping straight onto the sand, wind-chopped by the 18g23kt N cross-shore, no bank holding any shape - matches the VERY_POOR rating. Opened the detail crop and scanned the whole waterline in all 3 frames plus both crowd frames: no boards, nobody sitting outside the whitewater. Two dark specks standing in the shorebreak shallows near the lifeguard flag are bathers, not surfers, so 0 surfing rather than null. On land roughly 30: scattered groups and tents along the sand, a beach-volleyball style cluster at the right by the promenade, a few walking

11:31 lunch run. Cam clear, full daylight, no glare. Tide near the 11:08 low so the reef shelf is half dry - large areas of exposed rock and drained pools across the whole inside. What swell there is breaks well outside as short weak crumbly lines over the shallow shelf, chopped by the 18g21kt N cross-shore; nothing stands up as a green wall. Scanned takeoff zone, both shoulders and the inside channel in all 3 detail frames and both crowd frames: no bodies, no boards, no paddling lines anywhere in the water. Confident 0 out - the reef is simply not surfable at this tide and size. One person walking on the dry rock shelf. Cam framed on the water, land count not applicable

11:31 lunch run. Water fully readable, bright and legible edge to edge, no blowout. The bay is effectively flat: uniform wind ripple with only a thin wash breaking on the exposed rocks along the right-hand side, and reef showing through the shallows. No swell line stands up anywhere in the 3 detail frames or the 6 sheet frames. Scanned the open bay, the corner by the rocks and the shorebreak in every frame: nobody in the water. 0 out, and given how flat it is that is expected rather than a wasted lineup. Cam framed on the water, land count not applicable

11:31 lunch run - CAM IS BACK UP after being 404/dead at the 09:10 sunrise run. Sunny, deep blue water, excellent visibility. Best spot by a distance: clean waist-high lines peeling right along the reef with an unbroken green face ahead of the foam in several frames, held up and groomed by the 18kt N wind blowing offshore here. Counted in the crowd crops (higher of the two frames): a cluster of roughly 6-7 sitting/paddling in the left third plus 3 further out towards the middle peak, so 10 in the water; a couple more ambiguous specks not counted. On land 2 people standing out on the rock shelf in the crowd crops, plus roughly 10 more on the sand and along the promenade railing in the contact sheet - about 12 total, approximate. 10 out is below the 16.7 average for this slot

11:31 lunch run, wide distant cam so land counts approximate. Cam clean and bright, no glare. Wave is closing out: a continuous wall of whitewater running the length of the beach and dumping straight onto the sand, wind-chopped by the 18g21kt N cross-shore, no bank holding any shape - this reads worse than the POOR rating and matches the VERY_POOR it drops to from 15:00. Opened the detail crop and scanned the whole waterline in all 3 frames plus both crowd frames: no boards and nobody sitting outside the whitewater. A few dark specks are standing in the shorebreak inside the lifeguard-flagged zone - bathers, not surfers - so 0 surfing rather than null. On land roughly 20: a scatter of sitting groups and two tents along the top of the sand, a few walking, plus a handful by the rocks at the far end
